target: BRAWL Tactical Draft 1vs1/2vs2 and 20-second Hot Zone draft segments

constraints.gadgetInput: Single GAD2 touch target; keep original GAD/ULT/joystick/UI intact
constraints.multipleGadgetCards: May retain multiple GAD2 cards in inventory, but equip exactly one between rounds; never silently discard owned cards
constraints.hostAuthority: Combat and gadget effects resolved by existing authoritative game state, not client-only visuals
constraints.sameVolley: Normal shot fireActionId groups Tank's five pellets and Gunner's three rounds; on-hit effects with oncePerAction cap must share this ID
constraints.execution: No cloud publishing, production Firebase rules, or standard-mode edits in the design phase

cards.name: 分裂弾
cards.preview: 射程の約半分で通常射撃の中心弾が左右2発に分裂。1発は元弾の60%威力で、2発命中なら最大120%
safeguards: Tank's 5-shot and Gunner's 3-shot volleys split only the center projectile; never all five or all three
Until branching, central projectile retains original damage and geometry; it is replaced, not cloned, at branch point
Post-split each daughter deals 60 percent of the original central projectile's normal damage; both may hit for at most 120 percent total versus one target
Shot spread/modifiers must preserve per-shot damage event attribution and cap; no multiplying proc triggers by two
Sniper 36-damage center shot becomes two 21.6-damage branches (display rounding 22 each); Gunner 10 becomes 6+6
Bomber is treated as two smaller-area detonations with 50 percent of original blast damage apiece, at most original 100 percent to any one target if both overlap; do not create two full-power bombs
Split branches trigger delayed blast at most once for the original fireActionId; interaction priority/FX needs separate test

cards.name: 跳弾
cards.preview: 壁に当たった通常弾が一度だけ反射する
safeguards: Never ricochet through wall corners
Avoid projectile growth or extra bullets on Tank/Gunner
Bomber receives a character-specific bomb throw ricochet to preserve its existing weapon identity
Reflections are server-authoritative

cards.name: 反動射撃
cards.preview: 通常射撃+10%威力。撃つと反対方向へ60ゲーム座標分ノックバック（試遊版で増強）
safeguards: Damage multiplier applies once per pellet/bomb, not on top of resulting delayed explosion or GAD/ULT
Recoil affects the actor only once per fireActionId; burst fire is not 3 or 5 recoil impulses
Movement must use existing wall collision/spawn bounds and host-authoritative motion
Recoil cooldown does not suppress normal weapon firing or the damage buff

cards.name: 遅延爆発
cards.preview: 通常射撃で最初に当てた地点に予告が現れ、0.7秒後に小爆発
safeguards: Use fireActionId from original shoot event: Tank5 pellets -> <=1 blast; Gunner3 rounds -> <=1 blast
If a volley hits multiple enemies, first authorized contact alone generates blast
No chain trigger from explosion, DoT, ultimate, gadget, or split-child
Same opponent hit by one blast receives blast damage no more than once
Bomber's own area explosion also creates no more than one follow-up blast per throw

cards.name: ポータブルウォール
cards.preview: 追加GAD2で短時間の遮蔽物を設置
safeguards: Solid collision for characters and projectiles must be consistent across all clients
Reject placement overlapping character, objective or existing wall
Cannot trap players or spawn wall inside them
Never alter permanent KO/Hot Zone collision maps

cards.name: トラップマイン
cards.preview: 追加GAD2で接近すると短時間鈍足になる地雷を置く
safeguards: One activation per mine, one hit per enemy
Clearly show the mine to owner and teammates; reveal to enemies only inside intended detection distance
Do not store a second live mine without replacing or consuming the first
HOT ZONE must not become permanently impassable

cards.name: ホログラム
cards.preview: 追加GAD2で7秒間、本人と同じ外観の移動分身を出す。敵の射撃1アクションを受けると消える
safeguards: Seven-second maximum lifetime is long enough to feint and lure shots; it disappears early if hit by one enemy firing action
One Tank five-pellet volley or Gunner three-round burst counts as a single firing action against the decoy; not five or three independent decoy losses
Decoy moves along a deterministic, server-authoritative path compatible with wall collisions; no teleport-through-walls
Decoy cannot fire damaging shots, use GAD/ULT, charge ULT, capture Hot Zone, provide combat victory or count as KO
Decoy should visually copy its owner and avoid a giveaway indicator for opponents; owner and ally UI must distinguish it
Hit on decoy never deducts real player HP and should create a readable dissolve FX
Duration and cooldown clocks freeze during draft selection / combat pause, particularly Hot Zone's 20-second draft windows

cards.name: ワープビーコン
cards.preview: GAD2の初回使用でビーコンを置き、再使用でそこへ瞬間移動
safeguards: On teleport, validate end position, wall collision, occupied space and alive state on authority
Teleports outside radius or through invalid destinations must fail without clipping
Beacon is destructible and visible to opponents
Button must clearly indicate place/return state

cards.name: スモーク
cards.preview: GAD2で煙幕を展開し、視線を切って移動できる
safeguards: Smoke does not block projectiles
Own allies can still read teammate location
Attacking from smoke briefly reveals position
Use the existing fog-of-war/stealth reveal contract; avoid HUD information leaks
